tabs.label: Alltag
tabs.instructions: The same thing is often called something different.
text:
• das Brötchen (D) / die Semmel (A) / das Brötli (CH) – bread roll
  • die Tomate (D) / der Paradeiser (A) – tomato
  • das Fahrrad (D) / das Velo (CH) – bicycle
  • der Januar (D) / der Jänner (A) – January

tabs.label: Grüße
tabs.instructions: Greetings can tell you where someone is from.
text:
• Moin – north Germany, all day
  • Servus – Austria and Bavaria, hello and goodbye
  • Grüezi – Switzerland, hello (formal)
  • Grüß Gott – south Germany and Austria, hello
